description: Search active exchange-traded funds and products by ticker, fund name, sponsor, or ISIN, US and other exchanges. US ETF identity comes from the authoritative security-type reference directory, with assets and holdings from the linked SEC Form NPORT-P fund series when available; a fund listed on another exchange is named MIC:TICKER (for example XETR:SXR8) with its currency and ISIN. US matches come first. Use GetEtfProfile for analysis, GetStockPrices for a fund's price history, or GetEtfHoldings for a US fund's portfolio.

exchange.description: Market identifier code of one exchange outside the US to search alone (for example XETR); omit to search the US first, then other exchanges.

query.description: Ticker, fund name, sponsor, or ISIN (for example SPY, S&P 500, iShares, SXR8, or IE00B5BMR087).

name: SearchEtfs
title: Search ETFs
